admin.updateAvailableDetail: Updating restarts the server and stops every stream in progress. Back up first, then pick a quiet moment.
admin.updatesActionFailed: The request could not be completed. Refresh the release information and check that the host updater is online.
admin.updatesAutoHint: Checks every six hours. A badge and dashboard notice let you know when a new version is available.
admin.updatesAutoInstallHint: Backs up first, then installs your channel’s updates when no streams are active. Your server restarts.
admin.updatesAutoInstallSetup: Connect the host updater to enable automatic installation.
admin.updatesBackupHint: A local backup of accounts, settings, and watch history is saved before installation. Keep an exported copy somewhere safe, too.
admin.updatesBinaryHint: A host-managed command handles replacement and restart for your platform. The updater verifies the running build afterwards.
admin.updatesCanaryHint: The newest builds, earlier. Expect rough edges and more frequent updates. Switching back waits for Stable to catch up.
admin.updatesCompleteHint: Your server is ready. Your library and watch history are right where you left them.
admin.updatesConfirmHint: Install KROMA {version} (build {build})? Your server will restart and every active stream will be interrupted.
admin.updatesCurrentHint: Your library, accounts, and watch history stay with your server. You decide when to install a new version.
admin.updatesDockerHint: The host updater pulls the exact reviewed image and recreates only the KROMA service. Your mounted data and media stay in place.
admin.updatesFeedError: The release service could not be reached. The last known release is shown; try checking again.
admin.updatesLoadFailedHint: We’ll keep trying. Check that your server is running.
admin.updatesNotCheckedHint: Check for updates to find the latest release on your channel.
admin.updatesProgressHint: Progress is saved on the host. You can leave this page and return; it will reconnect after the restart.
admin.updatesReadyHint: The next version is ready when you are. Updating restarts your server and interrupts active streams.
admin.updatesReconnectingHint: The update is running on the host. This page reconnects automatically when your server returns.
admin.updatesSetupHint: Connect the host updater once to enable this button. Release checks work without it.
admin.updatesStableHint: Tested releases for everyday watching. The recommended channel for your home server.
admin.updatesSubtitle: A fresh version. A familiar library. Update on your terms.
admin.updatesSynologyHint: The KROMA package updates itself. Install the latest package once from Package Center or kroma.tv to turn this on.
